note: Counts come from the fixture: Value matches all four variables, of which scb/example's value and second are held, reference is unheld and sos/unheld is unheld; for 'Example reference' the register name supplies 'example' and only the reference variable's own text supplies 'reference'. Fails if the facet drifts from the variable arm's matching: holdings counting an unheld variable or dropping a held one, reference dropping an unheld register, or the multi-token register-context admission being skipped (0 rows) or loosened to any token (3 in scb/example, 1 in sos/unheld). The register-scoped step lists scb/example's three Value matches in reference (reference, second, value) and drops sos/unheld; it fails if `register` stops restricting the list or the listed ids drift from the counted admission. The `limit` step lists scb/example's first two matches (reference, second) while still counting three, and sos/unheld's one: it fails if `limit` cuts the count instead of the list, or the cut drifts from FQID order.
